businesses.business: life science reagents, proteins, antibodies, instruments and diagnostic tests

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures research reagents, proteins, antibodies, cell culture products, instruments and diagnostic tests for life science researchers, clinical labs and biopharma companies. Products are made in-house and sold directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: research reagents and antibodies; proteins and cell culture media; spatial biology instruments; molecular diagnostic tests; immunoassay analyzers

primary_services.value: custom antibody and protein development; contract manufacturing of reagents

customer_segment.value: B2B: academic and biopharma researchers, clinical laboratories, diagnostics developers; B2G: government research agencies and public universities

end_markets.value: life science research; biopharmaceuticals; clinical diagnostics; genomics

revenue_model.value: product sales: reagents, antibodies, instruments and test kits sold to labs and companies; service fees: custom antibody, protein and manufacturing development projects

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes reagents, proteins, antibodies and instruments in-house, sold to researchers and labs

geography_served.value: global: customers across North America, Europe and Asia, with sales offices in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: protein and antibody reagents, spatial biology instruments, and diagnostics and genomics tests sharing research and clinical lab customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to research labs, biopharma and clinical labs; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors in some regions and countries; online: web ordering of catalog reagents and kits

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: clinical diagnostic products face FDA and CLIA rules, research-use-only products face quality system standards
